cards.title: How much have I earned?
cards.body: Invoiced and collected revenue in one place, always up to date.

cards.title: How much room do I have left under my limit?
cards.body: Your flat-rate and VAT limits are tracked automatically, with a year-end projection.

cards.title: What do I need to do?
cards.body: One prioritized list instead of a pile of scattered cards and tabs.

cards.title: Does anything need urgent attention?
cards.body: Late invoices and upcoming obligations, on time — not after the deadline.

modules.heading: Everything in one place
modules.subtitle: The same modules you use in the app every day — no tabs you have to keep in sync yourself.

items.title: Invoices
items.body: Create, send, and track payment status — all in one place.

items.title: Clients
items.body: A client base with invoice history and contact details.

items.title: Limits
items.body: Your flat-rate and VAT limits are tracked automatically, with a year-end projection.

items.title: Revenue ledger
items.body: Generated from your real transactions, not filled in by hand.

items.title: Obligations
items.body: Tax and contribution obligations with their due dates, in one place.

items.title: Documents
items.body: Every generated PDF and attached document, organized.

attention.heading: Not a pile of cards
attention.body: Instead of piecing the picture together yourself from invoices, limits and tax obligations, Pausalac brings them into a single prioritized list — what's late, what's due, what needs attention. You always know where every number you see comes from.

items.title: Pick a client
items.body: From your client list, or add a new one in a few seconds.

items.title: Add line items
items.body: Services or products, with the total calculated automatically.

items.title: Send it
items.body: The PDF and email go straight to the client — status tracks whether it's been seen and paid.

faq.a: Yes — every new company gets a 14-day free trial, no card required.

faq.q: What happens when the trial ends?
faq.a: You'll get a heads-up before it expires. Until you pick a plan, creating new invoices is temporarily restricted — your data stays untouched.
Yes, you can change your plan at any time from your account settings.
